# Unova Estate — AI-Powered Real Estate ERP & CRM Software

> **Master System Summary:** Unova Estate (developed by Unova Software, parent portal: https://unova.bd/) is Bangladesh's all-inclusive AI-powered enterprise ERP & CRM suite, engineered specifically for every type of organization across the entire real estate and housing sector — including Apartment & Residential Developers, Land & Plot Developers, Gated Township & Satellite Housing Companies, Commercial High-Rise Developers, Real Estate Marketing & Brokerage Agencies, and Property Management Entities.

---

## 🏬 Complete Real Estate Sector Coverage

Unova Estate is purpose-built to automate operations for all 6 core sub-sectors of the real estate industry in Bangladesh:

1. **Apartment & Residential Housing Developers (আবাসিক হাউজিং কোম্পানি):** Floor plan matrices, unit bookings, flat handover snagging lists, joint-venture landowner ratio splits, and customer installment automation.
2. **Land & Plot Developers (জমি ও প্লট ডেভেলপার):** CS / SA / RS / BRS Dag & Khatian legal search, Mouza maps, interactive plot layout grids, and long-term 120-month installment engines.
3. **Gated Township & Satellite Housing Companies (স্যাটেলাইট টাউনশিপ ও মেগা হাউজিং সিটি):** Multi-sector master plan management, township infrastructure billing, utility NOC clearances, and recurring resident maintenance fee collection.
4. **Commercial & High-Rise Developers (বাণিজ্যিক টাওয়ার ডেভেলপার):** Floor space leasing, commercial milestone billing audits, raw material store inventory (rebar/cement), and contractor Running Account (RA) bill verifications.
5. **Real Estate Sales & Marketing Agencies (বিক্রি ও ব্রোকারেজ এজেন্সি):** Omnichannel Meta Facebook Lead Ads API integration, AI sales executive round-robin routing, and multi-tier agent commission calculation portals.
6. **Property & Condominium Management Companies (কনডোমিনিয়াম ও হাউজিং সোসাইটি):** Resident self-service portals, automated monthly service fee billing via bKash/Nagad, and maintenance ticketing apps.

---

## 🚀 Core Module Features & Technical Specifications

### 1. Omnichannel CRM & Lead Leakage Prevention Engine
- **Instant Meta API Sync:** Direct real-time webhook connection to Facebook & Instagram Lead Ads; ingests leads into CRM in < 2 seconds.
- **AI Round-Robin Sales Routing:** Dynamic automated lead assignment based on executive availability, project specialty, and client budget.
- **WhatsApp Cloud API Integration:** Automated instant greeting, digital brochure dispatch, and site visit scheduling on WhatsApp.
- **Omnichannel Call Audit Trail:** Centralized logging of phone calls, email exchanges, and chat histories with zero untracked lead leakage.

### 2. Installment Collection Automation & MFS Gateway Integration
- **Automated Multi-Channel Reminders:** Triggered SMS, WhatsApp, and email notifications scheduled at 7 days, 3 days, and on the due date.
- **Integrated Digital Payment Gateways:** Direct payment links supporting bKash, Nagad, Rocket, Visa, Mastercard, and Bank Wire.
- **Instant Digital QR Money Receipts:** Field agents and counter officers issue QR-verified digital receipts on mobile devices upon cash or cheque deposit.
- **Real-Time Ledger Synchronization:** Payments automatically credit buyer account ledgers and reflect in project-wise cash flow dashboards.

### 3. Land & Plot Developer ERP (Dag & Khatian Registry Engine)
- **CS / SA / RS / BRS Legal Registry:** Mapped master land acquisition records with instant Dag, Khatian, and Mouza search capabilities.
- **Interactive Visual Layout Maps:** Color-coded digital plot grid (Available, Booked, Reserved, Registered) for interactive sales center displays.
- **120-Month Installment Billing Engine:** Dynamic schedule calculator supporting custom down payments, balloon payments, and deed mutation fees.
- **Plot Swap & Reservation Lock:** System-level locks preventing double plot reservations across multiple regional branch offices.

### 4. Construction Milestone Billing & Raw Material Store Inventory
- **Mobile Site Inspection App:** Site supervisors capture geotagged structural progress photos directly triggering contractor billing gates.
- **Raw Material Store Ledger (Rebar & Cement):** Auto-match central purchase orders with site store delivery receipts to eliminate material theft and wastage.
- **Sub-Contractor Audit Manager:** Streamlined verification of contractor Running Account (RA) bills against verified physical milestones.
- **Unit Handover & Snagging Inspection:** Digital tablet defect lists during buyer flat inspections with automated sub-contractor task routing.

### 5. Joint-Venture Landowner Share Distribution Suite
- **Automated Ratio Matrix:** System locks assigned landowner flat and parking allocations upon joint-venture agreement sign-off.
- **Landowner Transparency Portal:** Dedicated portal for landowners to monitor construction milestones, booking status, and deed execution.
- **Automated Legal Deed Generator:** One-click generation of power-of-attorney documents, sale deeds, and allocation agreements.

### 6. Executive C-Suite BI Analytics & MD Dashboards
- **Cash Flow Forecasting:** Live visibility into projected vs. actual installment collections aligned with upcoming construction expenditure.
- **Multi-Project Gross Margin Analysis:** Real-time profitability breakdown across individual building projects and land blocks.
- **Sales Executive Quota Analytics:** Live leaderboards tracking lead response times, site visit conversion velocity, and booking revenue.

---

## 🛡️ Security, Compliance & Infrastructure

- **Bank-Grade Data Encryption:** 256-bit SSL encryption for data in transit and AES-256 for data at rest.
- **Cloud Infrastructure:** Multi-AZ AWS Cloud hosting with 99.99% operational uptime SLAs.
- **Automated Daily Backups:** Automated off-site snapshot backups with point-in-time recovery guarantees.
- **Financial Audit Trail:** Immutable ledger logs for all voucher creations, discount approvals, and financial overrides.
- **Regulatory Compliance:** DSE/CSE accounting audit alignment for publicly listed real estate entities.

- [Joint-Venture Landowner Allocation Model](https://estate.unova.app/clients/assure-group): Framework for automated ratio splits and landowner transparency.
- [Mega Land Township & Plot Registry Model](https://estate.unova.app/clients/amin-mohammad-lands): Framework for 45,000+ plot digitalization and CS/SA/RS Dag legal tracking.

- [Gated Township & Housing City Model](https://estate.unova.app/clients/rupayan-group): Township handover protocols and recurring maintenance fee collection framework.
- [AI WhatsApp Sales Assistant Model](https://estate.unova.app/clients/bti-building-technology): 24/7 AI sales assistant for instant floor plan and EMI calculation dispatch.
